diff --git a/tests/test_filter_by_status.py b/tests/test_filter_by_status.py
index 1197689..9b96798 100644
--- a/tests/test_filter_by_status.py
+++ b/tests/test_filter_by_status.py
@@ -1,6 +1,21 @@
+import copy
+
 from taskboard.tasks import filter_by_status
 
 
+MIXED_CASE_TASKS = [
+    {"id": 1, "status": "open"},
+    {"id": 2, "status": "done"},
+    {"id": 3, "status": "Open"},
+    {"id": 4, "status": "OPEN"},
+    {"id": 5, "status": "DONE"},
+]
+
+
+def ids(tasks):
+    return [task["id"] for task in tasks]
+
+
 def test_status_filter_is_case_insensitive_and_does_not_mutate_tasks():
     tasks = [
         {"id": 1, "status": "open"},
@@ -15,3 +30,87 @@ def test_status_filter_is_case_insensitive_and_does_not_mutate_tasks():
 
 def test_status_filter_returns_empty_list_when_no_task_matches():
     assert filter_by_status([{"status": "open"}], "blocked") == []
+
+
+def test_status_filter_matches_any_case_combination():
+    assert ids(filter_by_status(MIXED_CASE_TASKS, "Open")) == [1, 3, 4]
+    assert ids(filter_by_status(MIXED_CASE_TASKS, "OPEN")) == [1, 3, 4]
+    assert ids(filter_by_status(MIXED_CASE_TASKS, "open")) == [1, 3, 4]
+    assert ids(filter_by_status(MIXED_CASE_TASKS, "oPeN")) == [1, 3, 4]
+    assert ids(filter_by_status(MIXED_CASE_TASKS, "done")) == [2, 5]
+
+
+def test_status_filter_returns_empty_list_and_keeps_input_intact_without_match():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1, "status": "open"},
+        {"id": 2, "status": "OPEN"},
+    ]
+    snapshot = copy.deepcopy(tasks)
+
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks, "blocked") == []
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks, "BLOCKED") == []
+    assert tasks == snapshot
+    assert len(tasks) == 2
+    assert [task["id"] for task in tasks] == [1, 2]
+
+
+def test_status_filter_does_not_modify_input_list_or_task_objects():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1, "status": "open", "title": "Write docs"},
+        {"id": 2, "status": "DONE", "title": "Fix API"},
+        {"id": 3, "status": "Open", "title": "Ship release"},
+    ]
+    snapshot = copy.deepcopy(tasks)
+
+    result = filter_by_status(tasks, "OPEN")
+
+    assert ids(result) == [1, 3]
+    assert result is not tasks
+    assert len(tasks) == len(snapshot)
+    assert tasks == snapshot
+    # The original case of each status field must be preserved.
+    assert [task["status"] for task in tasks] == ["open", "DONE", "Open"]
+    assert tasks[1]["status"] == "DONE"
+    # Returned items still reference the original task mappings.
+    assert all(
+        result_task is original_task
+        for result_task, original_task in zip(result, (tasks[0], tasks[2]))
+    )
+
+
+def test_status_filter_accepts_non_list_iterables_without_mutation():
+    tasks = (
+        {"id": 1, "status": "Open"},
+        {"id": 2, "status": "done"},
+        {"id": 3, "status": "OPEN"},
+    )
+    snapshot = copy.deepcopy(tasks)
+
+    assert ids(filter_by_status(iter(tasks), "open")) == [1, 3]
+    assert ids(filter_by_status(tasks, "open")) == [1, 3]
+    assert tasks == snapshot
+
+
+def test_status_filter_returns_all_tasks_when_status_is_none():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1, "status": "open"},
+        {"id": 2, "status": "DONE"},
+    ]
+    snapshot = copy.deepcopy(tasks)
+
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks) == snapshot
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks, None) == snapshot
+    assert tasks == snapshot
+
+
+def test_status_filter_handles_missing_or_non_string_status_safely():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1},
+        {"id": 2, "status": None},
+        {"id": 3, "status": "open"},
+    ]
+    snapshot = copy.deepcopy(tasks)
+
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks, "open") == [{"id": 3, "status": "open"}]
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks, "blocked") == []
+    assert tasks == snapshot
